title: Pack records hold in any project they apply to
body:
Outcome: every pack record in standards/records.json holds in any project that matches its applies scope, so a pack never serves one project's conventions to another.
Proof: about 25 pack records were shaped by a single project (ids s-acf-*, s-css-*, s-deploy-*, s-skill-*, s-wp-never-mutate-production); see .krn/runs/lead/audit-t-nmywj2v.md.
Do: for each, either rewrite the text as a general principle or narrow applies (stacks, needs, paths) to the projects it really fits. Keep edit recall in test/evals/retrieval-denominator.test.ts at or above its floor.
